product_context: A healthcare management ecosystem including a main web application (role-based dashboards) and a prescription digitizer prototype (Snap-to-Text engine). The target audience and primary buyers are doctors, especially those running single chambers and seeing patients one-by-one. A secondary target is larger firms looking to accurately digitize bulk paper-based historical patient records.
layout_goal: A proper landing page which shows off the doctor's dashboard. Shows off the system UI as their product.
vibe_style: Trustworthy, modern enterprise, clean and minimal, with warmth and caring at the side.
inspiration_chosen: https://landings.dev/post/usepylon (Pylon Landing Page, but with much cleaner, non-distracting backgrounds so the Dashboard UI stands out clearly).
